mapper.select: SELECT P.PLACE_NO , P.PLACE_NAME , P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION , P.ADDR , P.X_AXIS , P.Y_AXIS , PI.IMG_PATH || PI.SAVE_NAME AS IMAGE_URL FROM PLACE P LEFT JOIN PLACE_IMG PI ON P.PLACE_NO = PI.PLACE_NO AND PI.IMG_ORDER = 1 WHERE P.PLACE_NO = #{placeNo}

SELECT P.PLACE_NO AS placeNo, P.PLACE_NAME AS placeName, P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION AS placeDescription, P.ADDR AS addr, P.ADDR_DETAIL AS addrDetail, P.PHONE_NUMBER AS phoneNumber, P.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, P.X_AXIS AS xAxis, P.Y_AXIS AS yAxis, P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO AS typeDetailNo, TD.TYPE_DETAIL AS typeDetail, T.TYPE AS type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLACE_REVIEW R WHERE R.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND R.DEL_YN = 'N') AS reviewCount, (SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1), 0.0) FROM PLACE_REVIEW R WHERE R.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND R.DEL_YN = 'N') AS avgRating, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PLACE_BOOKMARK PB WHERE PB.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND PB.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS bookmarkYn FROM PLACE P LEFT JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO LEFT JOIN TYPE T ON TD.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO WHERE P.PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} AND P.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT IMG_NO AS imgNo, PLACE_NO AS placeNo, ORIGINAL_NAME AS originalName, SAVE_NAME AS saveName, IMG_PATH AS imgPath, IMG_ORDER AS imgOrder FROM PLACE_IMG WHERE PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY IMG_ORDER
SELECT T.TAG_NO AS tagNo, T.TAG_CONTENT AS tagContent FROM PLACE_TAG PT JOIN TAG T ON PT.TAG_NO = T.TAG_NO WHERE PT.PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} ORDER BY T.TAG_NO
